title: Harborline SiteGuard Plan Comparison: Firewall, Delivery Network and Setup Requirements
content:
Firewall and content delivery protection differs by Website Security tier, and so do the conditions a site must meet for a tier and the way setup completes.

## Feature matrix

| Feature | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Web application firewall | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Content delivery network | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| CDN transfer included per month, TB | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 5 | 10 |
| Application-layer DDoS mitigation | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bad-bot blocking | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Known CMS vulnerabilities blocked at the firewall (virtual patching) | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Columns are the tiers Harborline SiteGuard Essentials, Plus, Pro, Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise. A CDN transfer figure of 0 means the tier includes no CDN.

## Site requirements by tier

| Requirement | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The site is reachable | Required | Required | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| A change to the site's DNS is possible | Not required | Not required | Required | Required | Required | Required |

## Setup

| Setup term | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Activation waits for the site's DNS to point through the firewall | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days after the order on which a reminder is sent for an incomplete setup | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |

On the Harborline SiteGuard Pro, Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise tiers activation therefore waits for the site's DNS to point through the firewall; on the Essentials and Plus tiers it does not wait for any DNS change.

## Points of comparison (hypothetical)

- A site whose DNS cannot be changed meets the stated site requirements of the Harborline SiteGuard Essentials and Plus tiers only, provided it is reachable.
- A site needing more than 5 TB of CDN transfer per month finds that amount included only on the Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise tier, at 10 TB.
